revision: primary analyzable set changed to STABLE CONCRETE OBJECTS (was mixed 72-word pool)

tier_policy.primary: STABLE CONCRETE OBJECTS only (furniture, containers, barriers/openings, tools, natural objects, household objects, structures). These carry stable denotation with minimal memory/convention/affect pull, so a rater judges MODULATION-FIT, not recollection or feeling-match. This is the ONLY set used for the primary analyzable endpoint.
tier_policy.secondary: neutral physical action verbs + low-religion structural abstracts + stable low-drama body/nature. Reported as a secondary/supporting stratum, not the primary endpoint.
tier_policy.diagnostic: kinship / religious / affect / social-register terms. NEVER primary. Reported separately as a confound diagnostic ONLY — a 'hit' here rediscovers babbling/register/doctrine/feeling convention, not varṇa modulation.

rater_wording: Given the dictionary meaning of the object, which option gives a more fitting inner tendency or field around this object WITHOUT changing what it is?
policy: broad but object-anchored; no cherry-picking after output inspection; final frozen list + full eligibility screen remains a downstream blocker; kinship/religious/affect/social terms quarantined to the diagnostic tier and never counted as primary evidence.
